files.README.md:
# Experimental routed static site

From the repository root:

```sh
python -m nexo web build examples/web/ssg/app.nexo --static \
    --routes examples/web/ssg/routes.json -o dist
python -m nexo web preview dist
```

Open the printed loopback URL. Home and Guide are generated automatically.
Member URLs come from `routes.json`; add a concrete URL there before linking to
it. Load `/members/7/` directly or use the normal navigation links. The pages work
with JavaScript disabled. Preview also serves the generated not-found page with
HTTP 404.

Deploy the contents of `dist` at an origin root on a static host supporting
directory index files. Configure that host's error document to `404.html` with
HTTP 404. Deployment below a subdirectory, async data and hydration are outside
this example. See `docs/rfc/0003-web-routed-ssg.md` for the complete bounds.

example.purpose: Finite routed static generation with nested layouts, typed parameters, normal links and page metadata
example.scope: Experimental M6b, origin-root hosting and portable slug paths only. Shared frontend compilation is checked here; associated tests verify generated documents, output ownership and no-JavaScript navigation. No hydration, async server data or production qualification.
example.source:
use nexo.web

pub layout Shell:
    view:
        header:
            nav:
                a("Home", href: "/")
                a("Guide", href: "/guide")
                a("Member 7", href: "/members/7")
        slot()
    style:
        header { padding: 1rem; background: #edf4ff; }
        nav { display: flex; gap: 1rem; }

pub page Home:
    path = "/"
    layout = Shell
    title = "Nexo static site"
    description = "Pages generated at build time, with no JavaScript."
    view:
        main:
            h1("Nexo routed static generation")
            p("Follow the links or load a nested URL directly.")

pub page Guide:
    path = "/guide"
    layout = Shell
    title = "Static site guide"
    view:
        main:
            h1("Guide")
            p("Each page has its own generated HTML document.")

pub page Member(id: int):
    path = "/members/{id}"
    layout = Shell
    title = "Member {id}"
    description = "The profile for member {id}."
    state initial: int = id
    view:
        main:
            h1("Member {initial}")
            p("This route's parameter was checked at build time.")

pub page NotFound:
    not_found = true
    layout = Shell
    title = "Page not found"
    view:
        main:
            h1("Page not found")
